column1: # Paths not taken: why a record item does not reach a proof by a path it could have (ADR-0023, Proposed).
# One row per reason, tab-separated. server/not_taken.py reads it against spec/claims.tsv (ADR-0019) and the records,
# and the server's not_taken tool returns its report. Which paths are taken is in the claims table and is not
# restated here; this table holds only reasons.
# Columns:
#   id        a stable id, never reused: N-<record>-<n>
#   from      where the path starts: a claim (C-0016-4c), a module (every claim of it), a record's item, or a record
#   path      claim      a record item makes a claim (from a record or its item)
#             property   the claim has an operator in a module
#             checked    TLC checks it on every reachable state at a row's constants
#             breaks     a row's counterexample shows the check is not vacuous
#             proved     TLAPS proves it
#             certified  every SMT step of that proof is checked by a second tool
#             alternative  a design the record did not choose (from a record or its item)
#   reason    design          someone decided against it, and the source says so
#             dead-end        it was tried and did not work, and the source is the record of the attempt
#             oversight       nobody decided: it was found missing on the date given, and still is
#             deferred        it is meant to be taken later, and the source says when
#             blocked         it waits on something outside the repository
#             not-applicable  there is no such path for this item
#             superseded      it was the path once, and a later decision replaced it
#             other           none of these; why says what
#   why       the reason in one line, as the source words it
#   source    where the reason is written: a record (ADR-0015 item 3, ADR-0015 Alternatives, ADR-0016 History
#             2026.11.16) or a file in the tree, named
#   quote     words of the source that carry the reason. The script looks them up there, ignoring line breaks and
#             emphasis marks, and reports the row BAD when they are gone
#   by        who gave the reason. A reason the assistant gave is the assistant's until the custodian takes it
#   date      when the reason was given, or for an oversight when it was found
#   evidence  rows of a named results file that show what the path would cost, as <file>: row row; or -
# A path that is not taken and has no row here is reported UNEXPLAINED. That is a true answer and is not filled in
# by guessing: at 2026.11.22 every ProveRequests claim's proved path is so. No record says why that module has no
# TLAPS proof, where ADR-0015 says it of PinLifecycle.
# The six oversight rows are the finding of COUPLING.md section 4 step 1, classed by the assistant: the module's
# header says five of the properties hold under every mutation by construction, which states the fact and decides
# nothing. The custodian may class any of them design instead.
